section.p: Consider a Markdown topic that uses a numbered list to describe a business process or workflow rather than a procedure.

table.title: Consecutive numbered list is a workflow

entry.codeblock: # Alarm Escalation Workflow The alarm escalation process consists of the following stages: 1. Alarm Detection 2. Notification Delivery 3. Acknowledgment 4. Resolution 5. Closure

Alarm Escalation Workflow

The alarm escalation process consists of the following stages:

  1. Alarm Detection
  2. Notification Delivery
  3. Acknowledgment
  4. Resolution
  5. Closure

section.p: Result: Although the content uses a numbered list, it does not describe actions that the user performs. The converter therefore treats the list as conceptual content and generates a DITA ordered list (<ol>) rather than a DITA task (<steps>).
